title: Prediction-Level Late Fusion Preserves Task-Specific Strengths across Heterogeneous Molecular Encoders for ADMET Prediction
description: Code and reproduction bundle for the paper "Prediction-Level Late Fusion Preserves Task-Specific Strengths across Heterogeneous Molecular Encoders for ADMET Prediction". Contains self-contained Jupyter notebooks that regenerate every main-text and supplementary figure and table from released ground-truth summary data (no GPU or network required), the qadmet training/evaluation engine, model recipes, and the Polaris ADME-Fang external-benchmark integration.
